description: This PHP script demonstrates API usage for setting up test projects, plans, builds, and platforms in the TestLink system, including support functions for creating these entities.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Standard PHP class used for creating generic objects.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: External class used for making XML-RPC calls to the server.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a test project via API call.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a test plan via API call.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a build associated with a test plan.

methods.name: createPlatform
methods.description: Creates a platform for the test project.
